categories.main_business_segments: SBI ARUHI Corporation operates a single business segment focused on housing finance, primarily providing mortgage loans. The group also offers related financial products such as real estate-secured loans, bridge loans, leaseback services, and credit guarantees through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as OCR (Optical Character Recognition), RPA (Robotic Process Automation), and AI to streamline loan origination, underwriting, and servicing processes. It utilizes securitization and asset-backed securities (RMBS) as core funding and risk management mechanisms, minimizing credit and interest rate risk exposure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SBI ARUHI serves individual homebuyers seeking mortgage loans, including singles, seniors, and foreign nationals, as well as real estate businesses requiring acquisition financing. Its main end markets are the Japanese residential mortgage sector and related real estate finance markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in Japan, with approximately 100 sales locations including franchise and directly operated branches, and also offers non-face-to-face digital channels. All business activities and customers are based in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: SBI ARUHI acts as a midstream player in the housing finance supply chain, originating and servicing mortgage loans, securitizing assets, and providing intermediary and agency services for partner banks. It also operates downstream through direct customer engagement and upstream via collaboration with real estate developers and agents.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining dominant market share in 'Flat 35' fixed-rate mortgages, expanding into growth segments (singles, seniors, foreign nationals), increasing recurring (stock) revenue, and strengthening digital transformation (DX) and operational efficiency. The company invests in risk management, product development for new customer segments, and ESG initiatives, but does not conduct traditional R&D.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through origination fees on mortgage loans, recurring servicing fees, insurance commissions, interest income from asset holdings, and agency commissions for partner bank products. Securitization and off-balance-sheet transactions enable a fee-based, low-risk business model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors are major Japanese banks and mortgage lenders, especially those offering variable-rate loans. SBI ARUHI is positioned as the market leader in the fixed-rate 'Flat 35' segment, holding the No.1 share for 15 consecutive years, and differentiates itself through product breadth and nationwide distribution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was 22.3 billion yen (up 9.3% YoY), with pre-tax profit of 2.4 billion yen and net profit attributable to owners of 1.9 billion yen. The company has over 200 billion yen in assets and employs 466 people. While revenue and profit rebounded in FY2025, the business has experienced moderate contraction in recent years but is now stabilizing and targeting significant growth by FY2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SBI ARUHI emphasizes comprehensive housing finance solutions, offering both fixed and variable rate mortgages, flexible products for diverse customer needs, and a robust nationwide and digital sales network. Its risk-minimized, fee-based model, strong operational efficiency, and ability to serve underserved segments (singles, seniors, foreigners) are key differentiators, along with its leadership in the 'Flat 35' market.
